name: Dryer Vent
summary: Exhausts hot, moist air and lint from the clothes dryer to outside.
education: Lint accumulates inside the duct over time and is highly flammable. Clogged dryer vents are one of the leading causes of house fires. Long, twisty runs to the outside need cleaning more often than short straight ones.

questions.prompt: Where does it exit the house?

suggested_photos.prompt: Where the duct connects to the dryer

maintenance.action: Clean lint from the entire duct run
maintenance.why: Lint builds up beyond the lint trap and can ignite from a hot exhaust.

maintenance.action: Check that the exterior flap opens freely
maintenance.why: Stuck flaps trap moist air inside and let pests in.
